summary: Wyoming household of two adults (married, no children, no one over 65, no disabilities reported). Household earned income is about $140,000 a year from work. None of the ten programmes appear to fit: SNAP, WIC, TANF, SSI, CHIP, EITC, the refundable Child Tax Credit, school meals and the ACA premium tax credit all have income or household-composition limits this household exceeds. Wyoming has not expanded Medicaid, and non-disabled, non-elderly adults without children do not qualify for it in any case. No programmes recommended. Hand-off not needed.
